summary: NPS primitive campground (Gauley River NRA, run by the Park Service itself; no concessioner, and USACE only owns the dam above it). Confirmed free; changed booking to first-come only, not reservable, 14 days in 28 (overrides the inherited rec.gov row); added year-round season, 18 drive-in sites with RVs under 25 ft, no hookups, vault toilet, no water/showers/dump. No current NPS alerts. Note left as is.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (internal, not an operator claim): the entry is 'not waterfront' but its note says 'with sites directly along the river'; NPS says only that the campground is 'located just below Summersville Dam'. One of the two is wrong.

Criteria (borderline, passes): NPS says the campground 'can only accommodate small (less than 25 feet in length) RVs and trailers' (rvMaxLength 25); EKKO at 23 ft fits, but the sites are 'close together'.

Inherited federal booking row (reservable via recreation.gov, 180-day window) is wrong here; this result overrides it with first-come only. The second website (https://www.recreation.gov/camping/poi/258782) is only a point-of-interest page, not a booking page.
